Cebuano

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish soneto, from Italian sonetto

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /soˈneto/ [s̪oˈn̪i.t̪o]
  • Rhymes: -eto
  • Hyphenation: so‧ne‧to

Noun

[edit]

soneto (Badlit spelling ᜐᜓᜈᜒᜆᜓ)

  1. sonnet
